blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: pivot — Element selected to split a quicksort partition.
partition — Rearrange values so smaller/equal values are on one side of the pivot.
Lomuto — A partition approach scanning left to right and placing the pivot last.
index — Zero-based position within the array.
divide and conquer — Solve smaller subproblems and combine results.

blocks.title: Pick a pivot
blocks.text: Use the rightmost element, 6. A left boundary i tracks where the next small value belongs.

blocks.title: Scan and move
blocks.text: Only values less than or equal to 6 move left. We move 2, then 4, without sorting those two values.

blocks.title: Place the pivot
blocks.text: Swap 6 into index 2; elements to the left are <=6, and those to the right are >6. Each side still needs sorting.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict the next state
blocks.text: 6 is larger than 5; 3 is smaller and swaps into the left boundary.

blocks.title: Worked example · Reveal and explain
blocks.text: 8 is larger; 2 swaps to index 1, giving [3,2,8,6,5].
